sentences.en: Yeah, and that was Steve's MO.
sentences.zh: 对，那就是史蒂夫的惯用伎俩。

sentences.en: Steve would tend to arrive to meetings a little early.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫通常开会都会稍微早到一点。

sentences.en: His question was, you know, why are you here?
sentences.zh: 他的问题是，你知道的，你为什么在这？

sentences.en: Why are you here now?
sentences.zh: 你现在为什么在这？

sentences.en: So, and if you didn't give an acceptable answer, he was like, you don't need to be here.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你给不出一个让人满意的回答，他的态度就是，你不需要待在这。

sentences.en: Get out.
sentences.zh: 滚出去。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast, episode 28, recorded on May 19th, 2021.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到 ADSP 播客，第 28 期，录制于 2021 年 5 月 19 日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today with my co-host, Bryce, we wrap up our three-part interview with Sean Parent, where he tells us some of his awesome Steve Jobs stories.
sentences.zh: 我是康纳，今天我的联合主持是布莱斯，我们将结束与肖恩·帕特的分为三部分的访谈，在访谈中他给我们讲述了一些他经历的史蒂夫·乔布斯的精彩故事。

sentences.en: Fast forward until after I left Apple.
sentences.zh: 时间快进到我离开苹果之后。

sentences.en: So, you know, I left Apple after five years and went to Adobe to work on Photoshop.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我在苹果待了五年后离开，去了 Adobe 从事 Photoshop 的工作。

sentences.en: And so I joined Adobe end of 93 to work on Photoshop.
sentences.zh: 所以我在 93 年年底加入 Adobe 从事 Photoshop 的开发。

sentences.en: And a couple of years after that, Steve Jobs came back to Apple.
sentences.zh: 几年后，史蒂夫·乔布斯回到了苹果。

sentences.en: So I always say I worked at Apple between jobs because I joined Apple right after Steve left, and I left Apple right before Steve came back.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是说我在两份工作之间曾在苹果工作过，因为我是在史蒂夫离开后不久加入苹果的，而我离开苹果又是在史蒂夫回来之前。

sentences.en: So I worked at Apple between jobs.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实是在两份工作之间在苹果工作过。

sentences.en: So Steve came back, and Apple proposed this operating system called Rhapsody,
sentences.zh: 所以史蒂夫回来了，苹果推出了一个名为 Rhapsody 的操作系统，

sentences.en: which was basically Next Step.
sentences.zh: 它基本上就是 Next Step。

sentences.en: And they said they were canceling traditional Mac OS, and they were going to move to Rhapsody,
sentences.zh: 他们说他们要取消传统的 Mac OS，并转向 Rhapsody，

sentences.en: which was Next Step, which had came out of Next Computing, which is a company that Steve had formed.
sentences.zh: 也就是 Next Step，它源自 Next Computing，那是史蒂夫曾经创立的一家公司。

sentences.en: And at the time, Apple had about 2% market share and was falling.
sentences.zh: 当时，苹果的市场份额大约只有 2% 并且还在不断下滑。

sentences.en: And so the idea of supporting a new and radically different platform on what amounted to a failing company
sentences.zh: 因此，在一个濒临倒闭的公司上支持一个全新且截然不同的平台的想法，

sentences.en: was not particularly of interest to Adobe.
sentences.zh: 对 Adobe 来说并不是特别有吸引力。

sentences.en: And so both Adobe and Microsoft had basically said, well, you know, that's very nice, but we decline.
sentences.zh: 所以 Adobe 和微软基本上都表示，嗯，你知道的，这很好，但我们拒绝。

sentences.en: We won't be supporting your new operating system.
sentences.zh: 我们不会支持你们的新操作系统。

sentences.en: And before I had left Apple, I had worked at Apple on the transition from 68K processors to PowerPC processors.
sentences.zh: 在我离开苹果之前，我曾在苹果参与过从 68K 处理器向 PowerPC 处理器过渡的工作。

sentences.en: So, you know, I kind of knew, you know, at the very low level kind of how the operating system worked
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我在很底层上可以说是了解这个操作系统是如何运作的，

sentences.en: and how it was brought up and, you know, enough that I could bring up, you know, with a high amount of compatibility, you know, a 68K box running in a PowerPC box.
sentences.zh: 以及它是如何启动的，掌握的程度足以让我能够以极高的兼容性启动一个在 PowerPC 盒子里运行的 68K 盒子。

sentences.en: And so I wrote this about a page and a half proposal that was known as the Cyan proposal.
sentences.zh: 所以我写了一份大约一页半的提案，被称为青色提案。

sentences.en: It was cyan because Apple always color-coded their OSs, and cyan was an unused color, and cyan is kind of a blend between blue and green, tending towards yellow a little bit.
sentences.zh: 之所以叫青色，是因为苹果总是用颜色来对他们的操作系统进行编码，而青色是一个未被使用的颜色，青色有点介于蓝色和绿色之间，稍微倾向于黄色一点。

sentences.en: And Rhapsody, I think, was going to be yellow, and traditional Mac OS was blue.
sentences.zh: 而 Rhapsody，我想应该是黄色，传统的 Mac OS 是蓝色。

sentences.en: And so I wrote this Cyan proposal, and basically it was a proposal for how you could have Mac compatibility
sentences.zh: 所以我写了这个青色提案，它基本上是一个关于如何在 Rhapsody 环境中实现

sentences.en: inside of this Rhapsody environment.
sentences.zh: Mac 兼容性的提案。

sentences.en: And this was while you were at Apple or while you were at Adobe?
sentences.zh: 这是在你还在苹果的时候还是在 Adobe 的时候？

sentences.en: Well, it was at Adobe.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是在 Adobe。

sentences.en: I wrote this proposal up and floated it up the management chain, and it went to John Warnock, who at the time was our CEO.
sentences.zh: 我写好了这份提案并把它层层上报到管理层，最后到了约翰·沃诺克手里，他当时是我们的 CEO。

sentences.en: And we had lots of conversations, and John was like, yeah, okay, if Apple did this, then we would support their new operating system.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了很多对话，约翰的态度是，好吧，如果苹果能做到这一点，那么我们会支持他们的新操作系统。

sentences.en: And so then we ended up in discussions with Apple about, okay, you want us to support your new operating system?
sentences.zh: 于是我们最终开始与苹果进行讨论，关于，好吧，你们想让我们支持你们的新操作系统吗？

sentences.en: And Greg Gilley was my boss at the time, and he kind of took point on most of these negotiations.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·吉利当时是我的老板，他基本上牵头了大部分的这些谈判。

sentences.en: And so at one of the meetings with Apple, this was fairly senior director of engineering at Apple at the time,
sentences.zh: 所以在与苹果的一次会议上，当时苹果的一位资深工程总监也在场，

sentences.en: Greg had asked, you know, if you don't do this, why would we support your operating system?
sentences.zh: 格雷格曾问过，你知道的，如果你们不这样做，我们为什么要支持你们的操作系统？

sentences.en: And the director of engineering from Apple said, well, you know, if you don't do this,
sentences.zh: 苹果的这位工程总监说，嗯，你知道的，如果你们不这么做，

sentences.en: I'm just going to build my own Photoshop and put you guys out of business, was his basic response.
sentences.zh: 我就会自己做一个 Photoshop，让你们破产，这是他的基本回应。

sentences.en: To which Greg responded, if you really think that you could do that, I suggest you do, because you'll make way more money than what you're doing right now.
sentences.zh: 对此格雷格回应道，如果你真的觉得你能做到，我建议你去做，因为你赚到的钱会比你现在做的事情多得多。

sentences.en: And that turned into kind of a heated argument between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 然后这演变成两人之间的一场激烈争论。

sentences.en: I, you know, at the time, I actually thought it was going to come to physical blows, like they were like chest to cheSt.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道的，当时我甚至以为要动起手来了，就像他们那样胸口贴着胸口。

sentences.en: Is this at Adobe?
sentences.zh: 这是在 Adobe 发生的吗？

sentences.en: Or like, is this meeting taking place at Adobe?
sentences.zh: 或者说，这个会议是在 Adobe 举行的吗？

sentences.en: This meeting was taking place at Adobe.
sentences.zh: 这个会议是在 Adobe 举行的。

sentences.en: And so they were literally like chest to chest, you know, pointing in each other's faces.
sentences.zh: 所以他们真的就像胸口贴着胸口一样，你知道的，手指着对方的脸。

sentences.en: So after this meeting, the person from Apple wrote an email that went to Warnock
sentences.zh: 所以在这次会议之后，苹果的那个人写了一封发给沃诺克的电子邮件，

sentences.en: that was that, you know, he could no longer negotiate with Adobe because Greg was, you know, was a hothead.
sentences.zh: 大意是说他无法再与 Adobe 进行谈判，因为格雷格这人是个冲动的人。

sentences.en: And so, you know, if, if, if Adobe wanted to continue negotiations, it would have to be with somebody else.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果，如果，如果 Adobe 还想继续谈判，就必须换个人来。

sentences.en: So I got tagged and was like, okay, so Sean, you get to continue the negotiations around this.
sentences.zh: 所以我被点名了，当时的情况是，好吧，肖恩，由你来继续围绕这个进行谈判。

sentences.en: And so we set up another meeting.
sentences.zh: 于是我们安排了另一次会议。

sentences.en: This one was at Apple and the, the meeting was supposed to basically go in, in two parts where, where Adobe presented, uh, uh, the, the business reality of why we
sentences.zh: 这次是在苹果，会议原本计划基本上分为两个部分，一部分是 Adobe 提出商业现实，说明为什么我们

sentences.en: wouldn't support Rhapsody as it was, you know, the cost to us of moving our products to a new
sentences.zh: 不会按原样支持 Rhapsody，包括将我们的产品转移到一个新

sentences.en: platform, um, uh, the opportunity costs involved, the technical challenges, and basically lay out the case for why we weren't going to do it.
sentences.zh: 平台对我们的成本，嗯，嗯，涉及到的机会成本，技术挑战，并基本上阐述我们不打算这样做的理由。

sentences.en: And, you know, in less Apple kind of met us halfway and, and on the flip side, Apple was going to present their analysis of the cyan proposal, uh, it was myself and Ross Bot.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，除非苹果能在某种程度上与我们妥协，而在另一方面，苹果将展示他们对青色提案的分析，嗯，当时出席的是我和罗斯·博特。

sentences.en: Ross Bot was, uh, uh, you know, uh, an executive at Adobe and he was handling kind of the, the number side, the marketing side of it.
sentences.zh: 罗斯·博特是，嗯，嗯，你知道的，Adobe 的一位高管，他主要处理数字方面、市场营销方面的事情。

sentences.en: And I was handling the, the technical side of it.
sentences.zh: 而我负责技术方面的事情。

sentences.en: Um, and so we go to this meeting and we do our presentation on the technical aspects and
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我们去参加了这个会议，做了关于技术方面和

sentences.en: the numbers aspects, and then it's like, okay, Apple, it's your turn to give your presentation.
sentences.zh: 数字方面的演示，然后就变成了，好吧，苹果，轮到你们做演示了。

sentences.en: And, uh, this, uh, same, same individual who had been in an argument with Greg, uh, says, well, uh, we looked at this proposal that Sean wrote and it can't be built.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，之前和格雷格发生过争执的同一个人，说，嗯，我们看了肖恩写的这个提案，这根本造不出来。

sentences.en: And like, that was it.
sentences.zh: 然后，就这样完了。

sentences.en: They had like no slides, no presentation, no numbers, no anything.
sentences.zh: 他们就像是没有幻灯片，没有演示，没有数据，什么都没有。

sentences.en: And I got mad and I'm like, I'm like, that's BS.
sentences.zh: 我当时气坏了，我说，我说，这纯属胡扯。

sentences.en: Uh, he was like, nope, I've had like all the best senior engineers we have here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他说，不，我让我们这里所有最优秀的资深工程师都看过了。

sentences.en: Look at this.
sentences.zh: 看看这个。

sentences.en: They say, nope, it can't be built.
sentences.zh: 他们说，不行，这造不出来。

sentences.en: I'm like, like you're full of blank.
sentences.zh: 我说，就像你在满口胡言乱语一样。

sentences.en: You know, if you just, if you want to hire me back, let me put my own team together.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你只是，如果你想重新雇佣我，让我把自己的团队组建起来。

sentences.en: I'll build it.
sentences.zh: 我把它造出来。

sentences.en: And, uh, so it went, it went really well then the meeting.
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，所以会议后来进展得，进展得很顺利。

sentences.en: So yeah, so the meeting went, went really, really well.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，所以会议进展得，非常，非常顺利。

sentences.en: Um, so, so I get back to the office and, uh, it, I don't even think the day was over.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，所以我回到办公室，嗯，我觉得那天甚至还没结束。

sentences.en: Um, uh, I get an email, uh, from John Warnock and it's a forward of an email from this director
sentences.zh: 嗯，嗯，我收到了一封电子邮件，嗯，来自约翰·沃诺克，那是转发自苹果这位

sentences.en: of engineering at Apple, um, uh, that says, uh, you know, that the whole problem with dealing
sentences.zh: 工程总监的一封邮件，嗯，嗯，上面说，嗯，你知道的，与

sentences.en: with, uh, Adobe, uh, was, you know, was, was me as, uh, as an ex Apple employee with an ax to grind.
sentences.zh: Adobe 打交道的整个问题，在于，你知道的，就是我这个心怀怨恨的苹果前员工。

sentences.en: And that I didn't know what I was talking about and, and I was impossible to work with.
sentences.zh: 而且我根本不知道自己在说什么，而且我根本无法共事。

sentences.en: And so this was just a forwarded email, just slamming me personally, uh, with a note from
sentences.zh: 所以这只是一封转发的邮件，纯粹是在人身攻击我，嗯，上面还带有

sentences.en: John at the top, uh, uh, that says, uh, uh, I want to see you in my office now.
sentences.zh: 约翰留下的便签，嗯，嗯，上面写着，嗯，嗯，我想现在就在我办公室见你。

sentences.en: So, uh, that, that was the extent of the note, uh, so,
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，那，那就是便签的全部内容，嗯，

sentences.en: you know, I went through my office thinking, okay, well, if I'm getting escorted out of the building, what do I want to take
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我走过自己的办公室时心想，好吧，如果我要被护送出大楼，我今天想带什么

sentences.en: home today?
sentences.zh: 回家？

sentences.en: Um, uh, and I, I called, uh, uh, I, I called John's, uh, uh, assistant and said, you know, as John sent me this note, he wants to speak with me now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，嗯，然后我打电话，嗯，嗯，我给约翰的，嗯，嗯，助理打了电话说，你知道的，约翰给我发了这张便签，他想现在跟我谈谈。

sentences.en: And she said, yeah, he's waiting for you.
sentences.zh: 她说，好的，他在等你。

sentences.en: Come on up.
sentences.zh: 上来吧。

sentences.en: Um, uh, so, you know, go up to the, to the 18th floor of the tower.
sentences.zh: 嗯，嗯，所以，你知道的，我上到了大楼的第 18 层。

sentences.en: It's, it's what you would expect, you know, uh, a CEO's office to be like.
sentences.zh: 那，那就是你会期望的，你知道的，CEO 办公室应该有的样子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, um, I, I get there and, uh, uh, John's like, Oh, Sean, come on in, come on in, like have a seat.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，我到了那里，嗯，嗯，约翰说，哦，肖恩，请进，请进，快坐。

sentences.en: I'm like, Oh, I'm like shaking and sweating.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，我当时气得发抖，直冒虚汗。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think this is the end of my career.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是我职业生涯的尽头了。

sentences.en: And, uh, uh, uh, he goes, just sit there.
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，嗯，他说，就坐在那儿。

sentences.en: Just listen.
sentences.zh: 听着就好。

sentences.en: I just want, wanted you to be here for this.
sentences.zh: 我只是，希望你能在这里见证这个。

sentences.en: And, uh, uh, he picks up the phone to his assistant and he tells her, can you get Steve on the line?
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，嗯，他拿起电话打给他的助理，告诉她，你能把史蒂夫接进来吗？

sentences.en: And she says, yes.
sentences.zh: 她说，好的。

sentences.en: So there's a pause and phone rings again and he picks it up.
sentences.zh: 所以停顿了一下，电话又响了，他接了起来。

sentences.en: He's like, Steve, I'm putting you on speakerphone, puts it on speakerphone and it's Steve Jobs from Apple.
sentences.zh: 他说，史蒂夫，我开免提了，然后他打开了免提，电话那头是来自苹果的史蒂夫·乔布斯。

sentences.en: And, uh, he goes, he goes, Hey, Steve, John, they go through a couple of pleasantries.
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，他说，他说，嘿，史蒂夫，约翰，他们客套了几句。

sentences.en: He goes, yep.
sentences.zh: 他说，对。

sentences.en: I'm calling you today about this Rhapsody thing.
sentences.zh: 我今天打电话给你是为了这个 Rhapsody 的事。

sentences.en: I just want to tell you, we're not doing it and we're not discussing it anymore.
sentences.zh: 我只想告诉你，我们不干了，我们也不再讨论这事了。

sentences.en: And he hangs up the phone and
sentences.zh: 然后他挂断了电话，

sentences.en: he turns to me and he says, he says, you know, he said for them to come back and say that they can't work with you when we had already told them
sentences.zh: 转过身来对我说，他说，你知道的，他说他们竟然回过头来说没法跟你合作，而我们之前已经拒绝过他们了，

sentences.en: no, and you're the only person who was trying to salvage the situation.
sentences.zh: 而你才是唯一一个试图挽救局面的人。

sentences.en: Uh, he said, is, is, is just ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他说，这，这，这简直太荒谬了。

sentences.en: He said, so, so we're done.
sentences.zh: 他说，所以，所以我们谈完了。

sentences.en: And, and, you know, I would leave the story there, but for your listeners, the time passes probably about a year and a half, uh, uh, from, from this point in time.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我本来可以把故事讲到这儿就结束了，但对于你们听众来说，时间大概过去了有一年半，嗯，嗯，从这个时间点算起。

sentences.en: Um, and I'm sitting in my office, you know, at Adobe working away on, on Photoshop and my phone rings and I pick it up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后我坐在办公室里，你知道的，在 Adobe 埋头处理 Photoshop 的工作，突然电话响了，我接了起来。

sentences.en: I said, hello.
sentences.zh: 我说，喂。

sentences.en: And they're like, hello, is this Sean Parent?
sentences.zh: 对方说，喂，请问是肖恩·帕特吗？

sentences.en: I'm like, yeah, this is Sean Parent.
sentences.zh: 我说，对，我就是肖恩·帕特。

sentences.en: And it's like, this is Steve Jobs.
sentences.zh: 然后对方说，我是史蒂夫·乔布斯。

sentences.en: I'm like, yeah, they're like, they're like, no, this is Steve Jobs.
sentences.zh: 我说，得了吧，对方说，不，我是史蒂夫·乔布斯。

sentences.en: I'm like, okay, well, hi, Steve.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，嗨，史蒂夫。

sentences.en: What can I do for you?
sentences.zh: 有什么我可以效劳的吗？

sentences.en: And he said, uh, uh, I, I'm calling to personally invite you over to Apple.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，嗯，我，我打电话来是想亲自邀请你来苹果一趟。

sentences.en: Um, I've got a presentation I want to give to some of the Adobe folks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我有一个演示想做给一些 Adobe 的伙伴们看。

sentences.en: So I'm calling each of you individually and inviting you personally to come over.
sentences.zh: 所以我正在逐个打电话给你们，亲自邀请你们过来。

sentences.en: So it gives me the time and it was myself and Greg and, uh, Mark Hamburg, who was, who was a technical lead on Photoshop at the time.
sentences.zh: 于是他给了我时间，当时去的人有我和格雷格，还有，嗯，马克·汉堡，他当时是 Photoshop 的技术负责人。

sentences.en: A couple of other people from some of the non Photoshop product teams also.
sentences.zh: 还有来自其他几个非 Photoshop 产品团队的几个人。
